messages:
maria: FYI customer on Private hit a collector failure when trying to generate a debug bundle. They see a redaction error and can't upload because their install is air-gapped. Raising for repro + upload plan.

ops-bot: Ticket created: SUP-4829 (assigned to kevin) :ticket: 

kevin: Thanks. Can you paste the request_id + exact collector stderr? Also which private build are they on?

maria: request_id: req_0a7b9c2f. Collector stderr snippet they pasted: "ERROR: redaction config failed: unknown placeholder ${USER_EMAIL}". They ran the 1.3.0-private binary on prod-vpc-3 (eu-west-1).

sre-jen: Quick repro checklist: 1) run collector with --collect-logs and --redact-config 2) capture stdout/stderr and systemd journal 3) ask for curl reproduction of failing API call.

eli: Curl repro they provided (org IDs masked):

curl -i -X POST 'https://private.acme.redwood/api/v1/generate' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'

response was 503 with body: '{"error":"upstream timeout","request_id":"req_0a7b9c2f"}'

maria: Customer can't reach our S3 endpoint (air-gapped). They can SCP to our bastion. I need a one-time SFTP user and upload path.

kevin: I'll DM creds to you. Meanwhile confirm the collector command we expect them to run (exact flags).

maria: Copying the command for them to run: 

```
sudo /opt/redwood/bin/redwood-debug-collector \
  --collect-logs \
  --include-kv-cache \
  --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.yaml \
  --request-id req_0a7b9c2f \
  --output /tmp/acme_debug.tar.gz \
  --redact-mode strict \
  --verbose
# If air-gapped: scp /tmp/acme_debug.tar.gz redwood-upload@bastion.redwood.com:/incoming/acme/SUP-4829/
```

sre-jen: Also ask them to capture journal & model logs:

sudo journalctl -u redwood.service -n 1000 > /tmp/redwood.journal.log
sudo cp /var/log/redwood/model-serve.log* /tmp/

kevin: Note on redaction: the error indicates their redact.yaml still uses the old syntax `{USER_EMAIL}`. New syntax expects `${USER_EMAIL}` or the collector flag `--redact-env USER_EMAIL`. Ask them to either update redact.yaml or run with `--redact-env user_email=value` for now.

maria: I'll send both options to the customer. Also asked them to attach the exact collector stdout (they had a 50-line dump).

maria: (after DM) Uploaded SFTP creds to my DM. Customer confirmed SCP works and started collector run.

ops-bot: Attachment received in SUP-4829: /incoming/acme/SUP-4829/acme_debug.tar.gz (size: 142MB)

kevin: Got the bundle. Next steps for us: 1) run the redaction verifier locally (tools/redwood-redact-verify acme_debug.tar.gz) 2) extract logs and grep for req_0a7b9c2f 3) reproduce curl against a staging replica if possible. I'll post findings in the ticket.

sre-jen: If we need deeper traces, ask them to enable --collect-profiles and re-run; but only if we can't find anything obvious.

maria: Customer happy with upload path; asked for ETA on analysis. Sending their contact so we can close loop once analysis is done.

kevin: I'll take it. If I hit redaction-format flakiness, I'll loop in eng-runtime. Otherwise aim for a first pass in 6 hours.

maria: thanks — closing the handoff here, will update customer that bundle is uploaded and under analysis. :thumbsup:
